note: Human sign-off on repair candidates that build/classify_repairs.py could not clear automatically. Keyed by source label. A FoodOn version bump re-runs the classifier and re-presents anything not covered here.

avian animal.rationale: class-rank (Aves): 319-node source subtree would link all avian food to all birds; too coarse to accept

bean plant.rationale: grouping over Phaseolus/Vicia/Glycine, but no-ascent means a soy query cannot reach it; a bean class query should return all beans

stone fruit plant.rationale: culinary grouping; fires only on a stone-fruit-level query

millet plant.rationale: polyphyletic but matches culinary usage and how the term is queried

sage plant.rationale: subtree is entirely Salvia (kitchen/greek/mexican bush, S. elegans); sagebrush is not reachable

thyme plant.rationale: clean Thymus genus grouping, no non-Thymus usage in food

chokeberry plant.rationale: Aronia grouping, all edible; distinct from chokecherry which has its own species-level repair

mallow plant.rationale: Malva grouping; marshmallow (Althaea) is a different genus and not covered

cattail plant.rationale: Typha latifolia and T. angustifolia, both edible

sorrel plant.rationale: subtree is entirely Rumex; Hibiscus sabdariffa 'sorrel' is absent from FoodOn, a separate pre-existing gap

ginseng plant.rationale: source genuinely mixes genera - three Panax species plus Eleutherococcus senticosus (siberian ginseng); applied for recall but tagged so it is visibly distinguishable

nasturtium plant.rationale: subtree is entirely Tropaeolum; Nasturtium officinale (watercress) is absent

sarsaparilla plant.rationale: products name Smilax aristolochiifolia explicitly; no Aralia present

black cumin plant.rationale: leaf source with no in-taxon; FoodOn does not commit to Nigella vs Bunium and nothing ambiguous is reachable

angelica plant.rationale: subtree is A. archangelica and A. sylvestris, both food-use; no toxic congener reachable

sumac plant.rationale: correct on its own terms; the mis-parented rye kernel in its subtree is a separate FoodOn defect tracked independently
